name: MongoDB Atlas
tagline: Managed MongoDB, Atlas CLI, Admin API, and vector search.
shortDescription: Atlas provides a managed database platform with Admin API, Atlas CLI, Terraform provider, search, and vector search.
agentSummary: Agents can operate MongoDB Atlas through API/CLI and use the official MongoDB MCP server for Atlas administration, database operations, query analysis, and schema exploration.
bestFor: MongoDB cloud operations, database provisioning, search, vector search, and app data.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Cluster changes, network access, and destructive database operations need human review. Schema changes, migrations, deletes, backups, row-level security, and retention policies need explicit review before agents touch production data. MCP servers inherit the connected account's scopes and may send prompts or data to third-party services; configure read-only or narrow scopes when available. CLI access is powerful but can run destructive local or production commands; prefer dry runs, preview environments, and non-production credentials.
pricingSummary: Public pricing with free clusters, serverless/dedicated tiers, and usage dimensions.
authModel: Atlas API keys, database credentials, connection strings, service accounts, and MongoDB MCP configuration.
browserSupport: Atlas UI is useful for cluster, access, logs, and billing review.

capabilities.detail: Atlas CLI supports programmatic cluster and project operations.
Atlas Administration API supports projects, clusters, users, and administrative objects.
Official MongoDB MCP server works with Atlas and local MongoDB deployments for cluster administration, database operations, query analysis, and performance recommendations.
Docs cover Admin API, CLI, Terraform, and vector search.
Public pricing with free clusters, serverless/dedicated tiers, and usage dimensions.
Atlas UI is useful for cluster, access, logs, and billing review.
The tool has documented test, local, preview, self-hosted, or staging paths that let agents validate changes away from production.
